name: Tethered Spear
summary: A spear on an invisible leash that snaps back to your hand after a throw.
description: The shaft carries a ring of braided silver wire that leads nowhere. Hunters say the spear dislikes being left in the dirt.

stats.effect: You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you make a ranged attack with it by throwing it, it flies back to your hand immediately after the attack.
